name: United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland
notes: National catalogue (Step 10.4). Source is Geofabrik britain-and-ireland PBF — not Overpass. Final points must lie inside approved coverage polygons (GB + IE admin), not merely the extract envelope. Isle of Man and Channel Islands are EXCLUDED. Do not activate until validation, storage, and query benchmarks pass. Keep stoke-on-trent active until explicit national activation retires the overlapping Stoke catalogue.

include: inhabited offshore islands belonging to the above (e.g. Isle of Wight, Anglesey, Outer Hebrides, Orkney, Shetland, Irish coastal islands within ROI/UK admin)
exclude: Isle of Man (Crown Dependency — not UK or ROI)
Channel Islands / Bailiwicks of Jersey and Guernsey (not UK or ROI)
any other territory outside UK or Republic of Ireland admin polygons
coverage_policy.inclusion_rule: point-in-polygon against approved multipolygon(s); chunk bboxes are processing aids only

chunking.notes: 0.02° chosen after London tile cost (~7 min / 0.02° at ~45k features). Prefer regional partition PBFs for chunk extracts.

distributor: Geofabrik GmbH (extract distributor, not data owner)
